rv.q: This peerless and polished production, which would make a wonderful holiday gift (especially for fans of the Reese Witherspoon film, on which this musical is based) is a pure delight.
Everything works. Casting is topnotch, including the ensemble. Choreography is amazing, and the cast has the talent to deliver it.
Everything is thoughtfully laid out and beautifully executed. This is a put together show, just like the main character, Elle Woods.
LEGALLY BLONDE is F-U-N and in vogue! Don't wait, buy a ticket and get to the show before the run ends this weekend!
Elle is played to perfection by Kayla Shipman... this is a smooth running play that makes 2 hours and 25 minutes go quickly.
